Liam (People Ops): Quick broadcast — SOC2/ISO attestations + annual privacy training due end of week (Fri 23:59 UTC). Please: finish training, assign an attestation owner in the sheet, and upload evidence to the secure portal. Links in the org doc: https://redwood.internal/compliance/2026. Short turnarounds this cycle, so flag blockers now. :bell:

ComplianceBot: Reminder schedule set (7d, 72h, 24h, 1h). Training module: https://redwood.internal/training/annual-privacy-2026. Completion tracker will update hourly.

Marcos (Eng): Will own Search infra. Will upload runbooks + change tickets later today.

Ravi (Security): For any service in SOC2 scope we need raw provenance logs (timestamps + request_id). If you can't upload raw logs to Drive, use secure portal and mark 'secure_upload' in the sheet. Redact payloads.

Keiko (Legal): Reminder: don't include contract-sensitive attachments in public drive. Vendor DPAs must be attached for third-party artifacts. Escalate missing DPAs to contracts@.

Marcos (Eng): Example secure-upload curl for logs:
```
curl -u $USER --upload-file service-logs.json https://secure-upload.redwood.internal/compliance/2026/search/service-logs.json
```
Make sure file names follow: org_service_evidence-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz

Hannah (Audit): Audit sampling: we'll pick 2 services per org. If you want a quick pre-check DM me your evidence link.

Liam (People Ops): Please add 'attestation_owner' and 'evidence_link' in the master spreadsheet by Friday. If you need help bundling artifacts, book a 20m slot: https://cal.redwood.com/liam/compliance-help.

Marcos (Eng): Added owner = marcos@redwood and evidence link.

Liam (People Ops): Thanks — final reminders will go out 72/24/1h. :white_check_mark:
